reviews.review: Did I hear a rock and stone?

You'd expect a game like this to get repetitive after a while, but it really doesn't
There's so much content and everything about this game just screams developer love, I can't say I've seen any other game get updates this good, this consistently

Ghost Ship never lets down. Worth the price, and worth every DLC on top. Rock and Stone!
Best game, loads of fun best community!
